title: rpl: memset one-past-end in dao_targets_authorized at /128 (pre-existing)
description: Noted by nie1 review pass 3 (pre-existing, not introduced by f9d16eac3b): in dao_targets_authorized (rpl_dao_process.c), the canonical /128 target path memsets &canonical[16] with size 0 (memset(&prefix[16],0,16-used_bytes) where used_bytes==16) — technically one-past-end pointer arithmetic (UB by the standard, benign in practice since size is 0). Same pattern may exist in other canonicalize-then-copy sites. Cleanup: guard or restructure to avoid the one-past-end pointer.
